items.title: Add the G01 positive-control baseline smoke
items.context: Create a deterministic smoke for one 15-row parent roadmap ledger where every row has fresh machine evidence and the rollup permits full completion without Authority or production claims.

happy.desc: Running the G01 smoke reports 15 total rows, 15 closed rows, no open/stale/deferred/invalid/migration rows, and full_roadmap_complete.

edge.desc: The smoke asserts the positive control cannot pass with fewer than exactly 15 generated milestone rows.

adversarial.desc: The smoke asserts local G01 proof does not set Authority, fullAuthority, production, or independent two-host completion claims.

items.userSees: Terminal shows parent-roadmap-large-ledger G01 baseline passed: 15 total rows, 15 closed rows, full_roadmap_complete, and no Authority or production overclaim.

verificationEvidence.note: G01 smoke passed and asserts exactly 15 rollup rows, 15 closed rows, zero open/stale/deferred/invalid/migration rows, allRowsClosed=true, and summaryClass=full_roadmap_complete.
G01 smoke passed and includes a negative guard where a 14-generated-row ledger throws the exact-count invariant, then evaluator reports missing_required_row and blocks full completion.
G01 smoke passed and asserts the synthetic ledger, rollup, and claim decision do not contain elevated Authority/fullAuthority/production/two-host completion claim terms.

items.title: Bind G01 baseline to validation and documentation boundaries
items.context: Expose the G01 smoke in the project validation command set or equivalent deterministic test path, and document that only G01 is implemented while G02-G10 remain future groups.

happy.desc: The G01 smoke is reachable through the deterministic validation path or documented command, and the baseline document names G01 as implemented.

edge.desc: The document keeps G02-G10 marked as future groups and does not state the full 10x15 baseline is complete.

adversarial.desc: Validation and documentation wording do not convert local G01 proof into Authority, production, fullAuthority, or independent two-host claims.

items.userSees: Documentation states G01 is implemented while G02-G10 remain future groups, and validation can run the G01 smoke by command.

verificationEvidence.note: Docs name G01 as the only implemented slice and provide the runnable smoke command; the command passes after packages/main build.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "full 10x15 baseline is not complete|G02 \| Future / not implemented|G10 \| Future / not implemented" docs/requirements/decisions/unattended-develop-mode-no-false-done-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs explicitly say the full 10x15 baseline is not complete and keep future groups G02 through G10 out of the G01 completion claim.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js && rg -n "guards that local proof does not become Authority, fullAuthority, production, or" docs/requirements/decisions/unattended-develop-mode-no-false-done-baseline.md
verificationEvidence.note: Retired-authority vocabulary guard passes, and the baseline doc states the G01 proof is claim-bounded rather than Authority, production, fullAuthority, or two-host evidence.
